comment: An intervention or trait acts to reduce the harm of a climate hazard (the object).
An intervention applies to a system; a cross-cutting concept applies to an intervention, outcome or impact.
An intervention produces an output or outcome.
An outcome is measured by an index or measure.
Lowers a climate-risk dimension (exposure, vulnerability, sensitivity).
Strengthens a capacity, capability or asset.
Partitive relation: the subject is part of the object.
Partitive relation: the subject is composed of the object.
Mitigation: the subject reduces greenhouse-gas emissions of the object.
Mitigation: the subject sequesters carbon in the object.
Mitigation: the subject (a system) emits the object (a greenhouse gas). Identifies a source; does not by itself make a term count as mitigation.
